title: Christmas Lights 🎄 Food bank Run
description:
A social, non-club, run to see the epic Christmas lights of Malvern Link and Support the Foodbank.  
Kids and others welcome so long as the can comfortably cover the distance. 

7k in approximately 1hr. Meeting at Victoria Park car park. 

To support the Malvern food bank at what is always a difficult time of year. I'd be very grateful if people could bring an item that I will take uo to the Lyttleton Well for them to distribute. 
I will add their current shortages/requests nearer the time to a discussion post but please feel free to bring anything you may already have that isn't on the list. They will be grateful for all. 

Some of the light displays we visit also hsve collection tins for various charities so please bring a little cash if you are able to to donate to them too. 

Torches and Visible clothing required. Christmas attire optional 🎄

Lirf : Robyn [Phone Number Redacted]
location: Victoria Park

title: Holywell Choose Your Distance
description:
Choose your distance!

We'll do laps around Holywell with potentially some small trail run detours.

Each lap is 3.6km and we'll loop back to the start so drop off whenever you've had enough. Great for those of you who might want to try for a longer distance without commitment.

3.6k / 7.2k / 10.8k / 14.4k / etc.

Holywell is lovely with a bit of a slope and some nice gas lamps, but no sidewalks so bring as many lights/hi-viz things you can muster!

We'll meet at the north entrance to Holywell. If driving: park on Wells Road or along Holywell and meet at the intersection of holywell and wells road.

6-7min/km - though potentially slower if you make me run round a hundred times, nobody left behind
location: holywell
